problemSignature.symptom: BoardForge had many one-off npm scripts but no canonical product CLI vocabulary for create, validate, route, cleanup, export, report, and replay.

rootCause: The local engine existed, but product surfaces needed a stable command layer that maps user-facing verbs to guarded engine jobs without bypassing protected-path rules.
fixSummary: Add boardforge-cli.mjs, root package aliases, dry-run job planning, dashboard report generation, replay command extraction, and protected ESC/FC path refusal.

testsAdded: canonical BoardForge CLI maps product commands to guarded engine jobs

conditions: Use as the shared local CLI entrypoint for web, KiCad plugin, and AI adapters
Use --dry-run when UI or AI wants a safe execution preview
Use protected-path guard before touching project paths

recipe: Expose canonical boardforge verbs as npm scripts.
Map each verb to an engine job or dashboard-data workflow.
Refuse protected ESC/FC paths before execution.
Keep replay command extraction read-only by default.
safetyRules: Do not execute route/cleanup/export on protected user projects.
Do not let web, KiCad plugin, or AI adapters bypass the CLI/path guard.
Do not use replay as an implicit shell execution path.
